versions.changelog:
byted-mediakit-editing 1.0.0

- Initial release providing audio and video editing capabilities with mediakit-cli.
- Supports 17 core functions including video/image editing, audio processing, and media composition.
- Tools include add-image-to-video, add-subtitle-to-video, concat/mix audio/video, trimming, speed adjustments, and applying filters.
- Designed for use with the editing domain of MediaKit CLI; requires mediakit-cli installed.
- Extensive parameter and usage documentation included for each tool.
